title: Material requests
itemQtyRequired: The requested quantity on line {line} must be greater than 0
itemDuplicate: The material on line {line} is already listed; merge it into one line
generateHint: Calculates each component's requirement from the work order's bill of materials (usage × planned qty ÷ base qty × (1 + loss rate)) and creates a draft issue request. You can adjust the quantities afterwards.
confirmSubmit: Submit material request "{code}"? The warehouse will process it and it can no longer be edited.
completeHint: Request {code}, warehouse {warehouse}. Enter the quantities actually issued (or returned); they default to the requested quantities.
actualQtyRequired: Enter the issued quantity on line {line}
returnLimitHint: The returned quantity of each material cannot exceed the net quantity issued to this work order (issues and supplements minus returns).
confirmCancel: Cancel material request "{code}"? This cannot be undone.
confirmWithdraw: Withdraw the approval of request "{code}"? It returns to draft and can be edited and submitted again.
submittedForApproval: Submitted for approval; the warehouse can process it once approved
